content:
Returns a list of up to 1,000 findings export jobs submitted in the last 3 days, sorted by the most
recent refresh time.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the ASSET_INVENTORY.CYBER_ASSET_MANAGEMENT.READ  and
AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE  custom role privileges. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
QUERY PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "QUEUED"
"PROCESSING"
"FINISHED"
"ERROR"
Filters the results by export job status.
Supported values include:
QUEUED —The request is waiting for earlier requests to complete.
PROCESSING —The request is currently being processed.
FINISHED —Processing is complete, and all chunks are available.
ERROR —An error occurred while processing. Retry the request, and if
the issue persists, contact Tenable Support.
integer
[ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 1000
Example: limit=100
The maximum number of export jobs to return from the last 3 days.
Note: Only jobs submitted within the last 3 days are returned. The actual
number of results may be less than the specified limit if fewer jobs exist.
status
limit
If omitted, the default is 1000 . The maximum value is 1000  and the
minimum value is 1 .
